description: Sera in a candidate SWIFT class outfit. Same brown eyes, face, high ponytail with blue ribbon and body proportions as the attached Sera references. Lightweight armor, short tabard and light combat clothing, a sword suited to agile forward slashes. Silver and blue with restrained crimson accents. No large shield, oversized magic circle or reused heavy GUARD armor. Dual swords are not required.
mustKeep: The character must be exactly the same size as in the attached size reference (the standing idle frame): same head size and same height when standing upright
Keep the same face and body proportions as Sera; this is a costume candidate, not a new character or a final approved design. No cape in these first-class candidates.
